content.intro: M5: Energy Governance for a Just Energy Transition | Chapter 1

content.text: This chapter provides a foundational understanding of energy governance and its critical role in ensuring a just energy transition. It explores governance principles, challenges, and frameworks necessary for navigating the global shift toward clean energy while addressing economic, social, and environmental inequalities.

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Introduction to Energy Governance
lessons.description: This lesson defines governance and energy governance, emphasizing their critical role in shaping decision-making, managing trade-offs, and ensuring a just energy transition, and discusses the three principles of effectiveness, inclusinvess and accountability

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Energy Governance Focus Areas
lessons.description: This lesson explores energy governance four pillars(focus areas), including inclusive institutions, regulatory frameworks, civic engagement, and oversight mechanisms.

lessons.title: Lesson 3: Cross-Cutting Approaches to Energy Governance
lessons.description: This lesson highlights four essential cross-cutting approaches—people-centered inclusivity, multi-level governance, digital enablement, and flexibility—demonstrating how they enhance the effectiveness, transparency, and adaptability of governance systems to support just and sustainable energy transitions.
